_help: Homepage test. The worker shows one version at fackt.io/ per visitor (share = relative traffic, 0 = stopped). The admin stats page reads this too. To end the test: set every share but the winner to 0, or make the winner the real homepage.
name: Homepage test

variants.name: Current homepage
variants.sees: The live homepage: ask bar and quote switcher in the hero, logos, who we work with, services, process, proof, pricing, working with us, notes and the postcard form.

variants.name: Simpler
variants.sees: Same design with much less on it: plain headline, results right under the hero, 4 projects as image and name, one line per service, no process, 5 videos and 4 one line quotes, one button everywhere.

variants.name: Work first
variants.sees: Short hero that names the pain, then the case studies straight away, logos and results, proof, one line services, pricing and a closing call block.

variants.name: Dark, reel and calendar
variants.sees: Dark page in the style of Intently: short hero with logos, a reel of the work, case studies as big images, short client quotes, the calendar right on the page, FAQs.
